item.title: Convex Optimization
item.description: This notebook records my study of convex optimization during graduate school. Convex Sets and Cones From lines to line segments Definition 1 (Affine Set, 仿射集). A set $C\subseteq\mathbb R^n$ is affine if, for any $x_1,x_2\in C$ and $\theta\in\mathbb R$, $$ \theta x_1+(1-\theta)x_2\in C. $$ Allowing every real $\theta$ means that the entire line through $x_1$ and $x_2$ lies in $C$. item.title: Optimal Transport
item.description: An ongoing study notebook on computational optimal transport. The main idea in these notes is to understand how deterministic transport maps lead naturally to couplings and the Kantorovich relaxation. Theoretical Foundations Monge Problem Motivation: suppose two discrete measures contain the same total mass.
